# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

print(df.info())
print('\nFirst few rows:')

print(f'\nNumber of -1 values in customer_age: {(df["customer_age"] == -1).sum()}')

# Check for the six QA orders with revenue 999999.99
print(f'\nNumber of rows with revenue == 999999.99: {(df["revenue"] == "999999.99").sum()}')

# Check for refunded orders
print(f'\nNumber of refunded orders: {(df["status"] == "refunded").sum()}')"}
